title: Commercial casework, built to spec and
intro: Pittman Woodworks engineers, fabricates and installs commercial casework and countertops for general contractors, owners and architects across North Texas, from shop drawings to final punch list.

capabilities.title: Shop drawings & submittals
capabilities.text: Every elevation drawn and approved before fabrication.

capabilities.title: In-house CNC fabrication
capabilities.text: Cut, edgebanded and assembled in our North Richland Hills shop.

capabilities.title: Countertop fabrication
capabilities.text: Plastic laminate, solid surface and quartz, templated and set.

capabilities.title: Self-performed installation
capabilities.text: Our own crews install, punch and close out every job.

industriesIntro: Healthcare, education, food service and retail spaces each carry different material, hardware and durability requirements. We build to the specification for each.
processIntro: A defined process from bid through closeout.

steps.title: Bid
steps.text: We review plans and specifications and submit a detailed proposal.

steps.title: Field verify
steps.text: We take site measurements and confirm conditions before drawings.

steps.title: Submittals
steps.text: Shop drawings and samples are issued for approval before fabrication.

steps.title: Fabricate
steps.text: CNC machined, edgebanded and assembled in our shop.

steps.title: Install & close out
steps.text: Our crews install, complete the punch list and turn over the work.

ctaTitle: Have a project out to bid?
ctaText: Send us your plans and specifications. We respond to every bid request within one business day.
